about: Decisions of the owner that change what the experiment does or stops doing. The report reads this file, so that a part that was not done is shown as decided and not as missing.

decisions.what: The final limit of the experiment is 1,000 real agents.
The simulation of capacity up to 100,000 agents is cancelled. It was not run and no simulated figure is part of the results.
Use is to be counted apart for orchestrators, agents and reviewers, and the sum of all of them shown.
No further experiment is started and no stage that was completed is run again.
